moodboard_intro: Round 1 (clean room: a sealed writer researched the late-90s East Coast rap video and album-art look and Nano Banana 2, nothing from the repo; no real rapper, no real currency). Nine looks: fisheye stoop / photocopied mixtape flyer / shiny-suit studio for the commandments; flash party snapshot / two-ink risograph / gel-lit print hall for 'own supply'; sealed press in a glass room / banknote engraving / VHS key-down-the-drain for the fix. Lyrics are still Jack's. Vote This / Maybe / No per still and note any beat.
